source_limits: Only the five named frozen source inputs were used; no online freshness or retrieval authenticity claim is made beyond supplied URL/metadata and exact JSON-to-TXT derivation.
Publisher rendered text drops embedded item glyphs. PDF renderings and extracted glyph letters reconcile all base item identities, costs, and quantities.

PDF two-column extraction order interleaves some numbered sections; numbered references and visual pages reconcile procedure order. All 32 physical pages were directly extracted and fully delivered, in addition to the full supplied extraction.

Faction board/card face artwork was not separately supplied. Track costs, VP, draw bonuses, relationship thresholds, and quest costs are correctly delegated to components by the summary and Law; no invented numeric track values were accepted.
Frontmatter play time and bibliographic/source-host metadata are not a rules claim independently proved by the supplied Law. No material gameplay claim depends on them.
Out-of-scope text was read to establish the full-source boundary and identify applicable FAQ material, but excluded rules were not imposed on this base scope.
omission_assessment: Core common rules, all four factions' complete phase procedures, base character actions, movement/crafting/battle eligibility, costs, quantities, destinations, limits and all in-scope victory modes are covered. FAQ explanations recoverable directly from stated procedures (such as an empty Decree column requiring no card action, and activation not removing a crafting piece) do not create a material omission.
